reviews.review_title: They stole my diarrhea so peak
reviews.review_description:
This game made me release the diarrhea from down below and they came to steal it. Healed my cancer in two seconds. Jokes aside: This is actually some of the most fun I've had in a horror game in years. The maps are pretty goofy and aren't too serious but they're still somehow really scary to play. 10/10 will keep playing.
Little problem, some maps were missing collision (such as the Bend map) and the AI for the monster in the Scary Circus kept running from me. Also some maps didnt have monsters, such as Veritee and Poppy's Cave. Aside from that best game ever!
